about: Architecture files whose bytes differ but whose output is bit-identical, measured on a real model. check_cache / pairing_problems accept a stamp pair whose ONLY difference is an arch_sha256 pair listed here for that model_type; any other difference still refuses. An entry needs a bit-exact comparison on a real artifact, never a tiny model alone. (runtime/equivalent_revisions.json is the same idea for the VQ runtime.)

entries.new_source: knurlogic v0.1.6 (1e7a0cab) same path: vendored edit 9, GatedDeltaNet conv/silu/split/q-k norm and gated output norm under mx.compile (KNURLOGIC_GDN_COMPILE, on by default)
entries.evidence: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B VQ-3.8bpw (pinned copy), three fresh processes: the old file registered as mlx_lm.models.qwen3_5, the new file with KNURLOGIC_GDN_COMPILE=on, and =off. Prose, code and literary house corpora, first 512 tokens each, full-vocab bf16 logits at every prefill position plus 16 greedy decode steps: 393,338,880 logits per arm compared as uint16 bit patterns, 0 differ in any pair; greedy tokens identical.
